content.question: What is the purpose of multi-head attention?
options: To repeat the same attention operation several times and average the outputs, reducing noise in the weights.
To split the sequence into chunks so that each head processes a different segment of the input.
To run several attention heads in parallel, each learning to attend to different relationships and patterns in the input.
To give every word multiple independent embeddings so that rare words end up better represented.
To ensemble several smaller Transformer models trained separately and then combine all of their attention maps.
content.answer: To run several attention heads in parallel, each learning to attend to different relationships and patterns in the input.
